end.summary: Practised position words: andar/bahar, paas/door, upar/neeche, on/under.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position words using containers, reference objects, and places above or below. Shaurya used paas/door correctly in all 5 attempts and upar/neeche or on/under correctly in all 6 attempts. They mixed up andar with on top when an object touched a container, and left/right as fixed room places; neither mix-up was corrected by the last time it was seen. At home, place a toy inside, outside, on, and under a box, then ask Shaurya to describe each position while facing different directions.

skills.skill: Uses near/far (paas/door) by comparing with a reference thing
Uses top/bottom, on/under (upar/neeche) to say where something is
Knows left/right and in-front/behind depend on which way a person faces

misconceptions.belief: Thinks "on top of" and "inside" mean the same thing whenever the object touches the container
Believes left and right are fixed places in the room rather than relative to the person facing
